title: Define Done Before You Start: A Goal in Five Lines
hook: "Fix the login bug" is not a goal.
points: Outcome: what changes for the user
Invariants: what must not change
Evidence: the test or flow that proves it
Stop: return when evidence passes, or authority is needed
Done when: both journeys pass
takeaway: If you can't say what done looks like, the agent can't either.

title: Don't Just /compact: Tell It What to Keep
hook: A bare /compact throws away what you need next.
points: Name what must survive: goal, decisions, evidence
Name the next proof you are working toward
/compact keep: goal, decisions, failing test, next step
takeaway: Compaction is a handoff to your future self. Brief it like one.

title: Don't Switch Models in the Middle of a Session
hook: Switching models mid-session costs more than it looks.
points: The prompt cache belongs to one model
Switch, and the whole context is billed again
The new model reads your history differently
takeaway: New model? New session, with a short handoff summary.

title: Work in a 250k Context Window, Not a 1M One
hook: A 1M context window is a ceiling, not a target.
points: Every turn re-sends the whole context
Long contexts get slower, pricier, and less precise
Past ~250k: summarize and start fresh
takeaway: The context window is working memory, not the system of record.

title: Compaction Forgets. CLAUDE.md Doesn't.
hook: Rules you typed in chat don't survive compaction.
points: Compaction summarizes, and summaries drop rules
CLAUDE.md is re-loaded on its own
Put the rules that must hold there, not in chat
takeaway: If a rule matters every session, it belongs in a file.

title: Cut the Noise Before the Agent Reads It
hook: Your agent is reading 10,000 lines to find one error.
points: PDF → Markdown or image
Logs → errors only
grep / find → scoped and capped
Read symbols, not whole files
takeaway: Trim what it reads, and it gets cheaper and sharper.

title: One Sensor. One Stop. One Budget.
hook: "Keep trying until it works" is not a loop. It's a bill.
points: Goal: the outcome, outside the loop
Sensor: a test or URL that measures it
Stop: the condition that ends the loop
Budget: 3 iterations, then escalate
takeaway: Observe → act → verify → update. Never keep trying without a meter.

title: The Builder Builds. A Fresh Context Judges.
hook: The agent that wrote the code is the worst one to review it.
points: Creator: owns one surface, builds against the goal
Verifier: fresh context, starts from the goal
Prompt: "Assume the implementation is wrong. Find the evidence."
takeaway: Each handoff carries: result · evidence · open questions · next owner.

title: Path Rules Set the Floor: Risk-Tiered Review for Agent PRs
hook: Not every agent PR needs the same reviewer.
points: Low risk → automated checks
Medium risk → code owner
High risk → senior approval
Path rules set the floor; the router can only raise it
takeaway: Let AI triage risk, but never let it lower the bar.

title: Failure Should Improve the Next Run
hook: A restart is an action. Recovery is an outcome.
points: Contain the blast radius
Capture direct evidence
Extract the failure class
Ship the lesson as a reusable guard
takeaway: Robust survives the shock. Antifragile learns from it.

title: Build Your Agent Factory, Not Your Vendor's
hook: Your agent workflow shouldn't die when you change models.
points: Model gateway: swap providers with one config change
MCP for tools, Markdown for skills and rules
AGENTS.md next to CLAUDE.md
Contracts between stations, not vendor APIs
takeaway: Own the factory. Rent the models.

title: Observability for an AI Software Factory: Measure Tasks, Not Tokens
hook: Can you see what your agents are doing right now?
points: Agent layer: OpenTelemetry, traces, cost per task
Delivery layer: lead time, review wait, rework
Factory floor: each station, queue, and blocker
